title: Responsiveness: the dashboard on the director’s phone

videos.script: This is the dashboard from the last lesson, on a laptop. And this is the same dashboard on the director's phone. {{phone}} Everything is there, and nothing can be read. The page has been shrunk to fit, so the labels are a third of their size. {{shrunk}} The director zooms in, drags it around, loses the number they wanted, and gives up. {{zoom}} Now the same content, reflowed. The two numbers stacked at the top. The trend below them, as wide as the screen. The breakdown under that, as bars with their names on top. {{reflowed}} Nothing was removed. It was rearranged for a screen that is narrow, that scrolls, and that is touched rather than pointed at. {{rearranged}} This lesson is about that rearranging: the order, the charts that survive, the size of a fingertip, and a page that does it by itself. {{plan}}
